extDescription.message: Enhance Google Scholar: authorship roles, CCF & CORE ranks, conference awards, year distribution charts, and instant search.

marksHint.message: From the authors' own words in each paper's title and venue text on Scholar (not checked), and from a bundled list of award-winning papers at major conferences.

marksAsWritten.message: from the authors' own words or the award list

tipHidden.message: Scholar truncated the author list, so the profile owner's position is not visible

coverHidden.message: $N1$ roles hidden by truncated author lists

coverHiddenOne.message: 1 role hidden by a truncated author list

resolveHint.message: Opens each paper's page on Scholar (about one per second) to read the full author list.

resolveHintSemantic.message: Asks Semantic Scholar for each paper's author list first (it receives only the title), then opens Scholar's page for the rest (about one per second).

resolveCaptcha.message: Google asked for a CAPTCHA. Solve it in a normal tab, then try again.

coverAbsent.message: $N1$ papers where the profile name is not in the author list

coverAbsentOne.message: 1 paper where the profile name is not in the author list

coverUnmatched.message: $N1$ papers at venues without a rank

coverUnmatchedOne.message: 1 paper at a venue without a rank

layoutWarning.message: Scholar's page layout seems to have changed: this extension cannot read the author lines. Please report it.

variantsTitle.message: Name not matching? Add a spelling

variantAutoTip.message: Added automatically: your profile name in the other order finds you in $1 papers

variantSuggestTip.message: Appears in $1 papers whose author list does not otherwise name you — click to add this spelling

dataNote.message: Ranks come from today's $N1$ lists, not the rank at publication time. CCF states that its list is not a basis for academic evaluation.

noRanksNote.message: No venue on this profile is on the $N1$ lists, which cover computer science.

rulePrefix.message: Matched by the visible part of a truncated name

tipToday.message: current list, not the rank at publication

popupNotProfile.message: Open a Google Scholar author profile to see its summary here.

optPreviewNote.message: Sample papers as they will look on a Scholar profile. “A Author” is you.

optRolesHint.message: Each position gets its own row colour. Papers where you are in the middle stay plain.

optMarkName.message: Mark my name in the author line

optMarkNameHint.message: Bold and tinted. Hover it to see your position.

optCopyHint.message: Which buttons copy or save the papers shown, or the summary, as text. The panel and the toolbar popup offer the same ones; with none on, there is no copy row.

optMarkAwardHint.message: Best, outstanding and distinguished paper, honorable mention, test of time, and best-paper finalists.

optPanelShowHint.message: The panel in the right-hand column of a profile page. Off: only the paper list is marked up.

optPanelSummaryHint.message: The table of your papers by position and rank, with the note on where the ranks come from.

optPanelMarksHint.message: The count of award-winning papers and talk levels, one click to list them.

optPanelStatusHint.message: How many papers are loaded, the “Load all” button, what could not be read, and the list of papers at venues without a rank.

optPanelNamesHint.message: “Name not matching? Add a spelling” and the suggestions for your name.

optPanelCompact.message: Compact: filters and citation totals only

optPanelFiltersHint.message: The search box, the quick filters, the highlighted-only switch and the year range.

optPanelMetricsHint.message: Papers, citations, h-index and i10-index of the highlighted papers.

optCacheCount.message: $N1$ papers' author lists are saved on this device (kept for 90 days).

optCacheCountOne.message: 1 paper's author list is saved on this device (kept for 90 days).

optResetConfirm.message: Reset all of these settings to their defaults?

optStorage.message: Settings stay in your browser and sync with your Chrome profile. Scholar pages are read only when you open them, and paper titles go to Semantic Scholar only if you switch that on.

optAutoLoadHint.message: Scholar shows only the first papers at first. This presses its own “Show more” button for you, about once a second, until the whole list is loaded, and stops if Scholar stops answering. Off: the panel offers “Load all” instead.

loadStalled.message: Scholar sent no more papers ($N1$ loaded). Try “Load all” again in a moment.

optHideHint.message: Hide parts of the profile page that repeat the panel or that you do not use. Nothing is hidden until you switch it on.

optHideCitedHint.message: The citations, h-index and i10-index table and its graph: the panel shows the same totals for the highlighted papers.

optHideCoHint.message: The list of co-authors in the sidebar.

optHideAccessHint.message: The public access box in the sidebar.

optMergeHint.message: Some profiles list one paper several times.

optMergeLabelHint.message: Entries with the same title (capitals, accents and punctuation aside) and the same first author become one: the most cited stays and shows the citations of all of them. The panel counts it once.

mergedTip.message: Merged from $N1$ entries: the citations of all of them

optLanguageHint.message: The language of this extension, and of the Scholar pages you open.

optLanguageScholarHint.message: A Scholar page you open in another language (a shared link, say) is opened again in this one.

optColorsHint.message: The colour of each authorship role: rows, name marks, the panel and the toolbar popup.

optContrastTip.message: Contrast of this colour with Scholar's white page. 3:1 or more keeps the row's bar visible.

optTalkRowsHint.message: How the talk levels are counted. Together, a paper that has more than one of them counts once.

optSemanticHint.message: A second place to look for what Scholar cuts off.

optSemanticLabel.message: Read author lists from Semantic Scholar first

optSemanticLabelHint.message: When you press Read full lists, ask Semantic Scholar for each paper's full author list first (it receives the paper's title and nothing else), and open Scholar's own page only for what it does not know. Fewer requests to Scholar, so fewer CAPTCHAs.

optPanelYearsHint.message: A bar for each year, in the role colours.

optPanelVenuesHint.message: The ranked venues of your highlighted papers, most frequent first; click one to list its papers.

optCopyDiagnostics.message: Copy details for a bug report

optSemanticKeyHint.message: A free key from semanticscholar.org/product/api avoids the rate limit shared by everyone who has none. It stays on this device (not synced) and is sent only to Semantic Scholar.

resolveSemanticBusy.message: Semantic Scholar asked to slow down, so Scholar's own pages were used for the rest.

noRolesHint.message: No author position is switched on, so nothing is highlighted.

resolveSemanticKey.message: Semantic Scholar did not accept the API key, so Scholar's own pages were used for the rest.

optHideCitedTableHint.message: The citations, h-index and i10-index table in the sidebar.

optHideCitedChartHint.message: The yearly citation histogram in the sidebar.

optConfigHint.message: Settings as JSON: copy them, save them to a file, load a file, or paste a change into the editor. A preset changes only what it names, and the page says what it applied and what it ignored.

optConfigNothing.message: Nothing to change: the settings already say that.

optAgentHint.message: Copy a guide that lists every setting, its values and your current choices. Paste it to your AI assistant, say what you want, then paste its answer into the configuration editor below and press Apply.

optCacheEmpty.message: No paper details have been saved on this device yet.

optChipsHint.message: The small labels after a paper's venue: its ranks, and awards or talks.

optPanelOrderHint.message: From top to bottom. A part that is switched off keeps its place.

optTableNote.message: Note on where the ranks come from

optMetricsScope.message: Line naming the positions that count

optStatusCutoff.message: Cut-off author lists, and Read full lists

optSaveFailed.message: Not saved: Chrome limits how often settings can be written. Wait a moment and change it again.

optNameTip.message: Your own name for this, in every language. Empty: the standard name.

optPreviewEdit.message: Hover a part to hide it (✕) or move it (⠿). Double-click a name to rename it.

optRenameHint.message: Enter keeps it · Esc cancels · empty: the standard name

optVenueHint.message: Paste a venue as Scholar prints it (the grey line under a paper) to see what the CCF and CORE lists make of it, and by which rule. A venue they cannot place gets no rank: nothing is guessed.

optVenuePlaceholder.message: e.g. Proceedings of the IEEE conference on computer vision and pattern recognition

optVenueNone.message: No rank. The lists do not place this text with certainty, so it gets no badge.

optVenueSecondary.message: “$N1$” marks a secondary track (a workshop, a poster, a short paper …): it gets no rank unless the venue's own name has that word.
